notes:
Requested Cohen's f^2 is not printed in the replication report; extracted printed R^2 without conversion. Reported n = 379 and t degrees of freedom = 378 are internally inconsistent for the stated simple regression; preserved both as printed. Original statistics quoted in the replication report were not treated as original-paper extraction. Original DOI landing page returned 403 challenge; Unpaywall and OpenAlex supplied no OA full text; Cologne repository timed out; original authors' OSF project returned 401. No paid or signed-in acquisition used.
Source follow-up: Fresh blind original-only validation. Source is the supplied published-article text, verified against the title and DOI on PDF page 1. Locator p. 5 is ambiguous: Study 1 reports a main association, demographic associations and an adjusted association, while Studies 2a/2b are introduced on the same page. The requested Cohen's f^2 appears on that page in an a priori power calculation, not an observed target-test result. It is therefore not extracted as an observed effect. No values are assigned without a uniquely identified target test. Replication and reported success are unassigned placeholders.
